fact: A March 2026 civil-society working draft, issued for public consultation and marked unofficial, proposes a Cybercrime and Digital Space Protection Law that would repeal Law No. 5 of 2022 on cybercrime.
title: مسودة قانون الجرائم الإلكترونية وحماية الفضاء الرقمي في ليبيا
